notes.title: Creeping Deck Prologue is out NOW!
notes.content:
Creeping Deck Prologue is now available for free!

We're so glad to announce the Prologue of our strategic roguelite deck-builder in collaboration with our friends from Miju Games! 

[previewyoutube=Lq1Hax6jukg;full][/previewyoutube]

The Prologue includes:

 3 full temples, and their furious bosses
 5 types of ennemies, from mummies to scorpions
 50+ cards available to build your deck and tons of combinaisons!


Feel free to join our Discord if you have any feedback! And if you want to support us and be informed about the progress of the full game, wishlist it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2167550/Creeping_Deck_Pharaohs_Curse/


Have fun!
